title: Product Designer
description: Master modern digital product design from design thinking, typography, and design systems to high-fidelity prototyping, user research, DesignOps, and executive strategy.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.focus: Design Thinking, Visual Hierarchy, Typography, Color & Figma Mastery

phases.title: Core Product Design
phases.focus: Design Systems, Low-Fi Wireframing, User Research, Interaction & Mobile Patterns

phases.title: Advanced Systems & Strategy
phases.focus: Developer Handoff, DesignOps, Quantitative Analytics, Enterprise & AI UX

phases.title: Mastery & Executive Impact
phases.focus: Design Strategy, ROI Alignment, and Portfolio Case Study Storytelling

nodes.title: Design Thinking & Problem Framing
nodes.subtitle: Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, Test, double diamond model
learning_objectives: Apply the Double Diamond framework to diverge on problem space and converge on solutions
Formulate clear 'How Might We' (HMW) statements
feynman_prompts: Explain the Double Diamond design process to a non-designer.
key_misconceptions: Jumping immediately into visual solutions before deeply framing the core user problem

nodes.title: Visual Hierarchy, Typography & Layout
nodes.subtitle: Scale, contrast, whitespace, modular type scales, vertical rhythm, 8pt grid
learning_objectives: Establish visual hierarchy using contrast, scale, and typographic pairing
Implement an 8-point spatial grid system across screen layouts
feynman_prompts: How does whitespace guide a user's eye more effectively than lines and borders?
key_misconceptions: Treating whitespace as empty wasted space rather than an active design element

nodes.title: Color Systems & Accessibility (WCAG)
nodes.subtitle: Color psychology, HSL palettes, semantic tokens, WCAG 2.1 AA/AAA contrast ratios
learning_objectives: Construct accessible light and dark mode palettes with proper contrast ratios
Define semantic color tokens (surface, primary, error, success)
feynman_prompts: Why is using color alone insufficient to convey state or error in UI?
key_misconceptions: Assuming that attractive color palettes automatically satisfy accessibility requirements

nodes.title: Figma Fundamentals & Auto Layout
nodes.subtitle: Frames vs groups, constraints, Auto Layout v5, component properties, variants
learning_objectives: Build fully responsive UI components utilizing nested Auto Layout
Configure component properties, variants, and boolean toggles
feynman_prompts: Explain how Auto Layout mirrors CSS Flexbox in web development.
key_misconceptions: Using manual absolute positioning and groups instead of responsive Auto Layout

nodes.title: Design Systems & Design Tokens
nodes.subtitle: Atomic design (atoms, molecules, organisms), design tokens, naming conventions, versioning
learning_objectives: Structure a scalable design system using Atomic Design hierarchy
Define and export platform-agnostic design tokens (JSON/CSS/Variables)
feynman_prompts: What is the role of design tokens in bridging Figma components with production frontend code?
key_misconceptions: Viewing a design system as merely a UI component sticker sheet rather than living infrastructure

nodes.title: Information Architecture & Low-Fidelity Wireframing
nodes.subtitle: Site maps, user flows, content hierarchy, rapid grayscale wireframing
learning_objectives: Map complex multi-step application flows using standardized flow diagrams
Produce clear low-fidelity wireframes that focus on structure over decoration
feynman_prompts: Why should low-fidelity wireframes avoid color and detailed typography?
key_misconceptions: Designing high-fidelity screens before validating user flow and information architecture

nodes.title: User Research & Generative Discovery
nodes.subtitle: 1:1 user interviews, surveys, affinity mapping, empathy maps, journey mapping
learning_objectives: Conduct unbiased generative user interviews without leading questions
Synthesize qualitative interview notes into affinity clusters and persona archetypes
feynman_prompts: Why are 'Would you buy this?' survey questions notoriously unreliable in user research?
key_misconceptions: Confusing what users say they want with their actual observed underlying behaviors

nodes.title: Interaction Design & UI Patterns
nodes.subtitle: Affordances, signifiers, mental models, navigation paradigms, input forms
learning_objectives: Choose optimal navigation patterns (tabs, drawers, breadcrumbs) based on content depth
Design intuitive form validation and progressive disclosure workflows
feynman_prompts: What is the difference between an affordance and a signifier in digital UI?
key_misconceptions: Reinventing standard UI patterns (like form inputs or checkboxes) at the expense of usability

nodes.title: Micro-Interactions & UI Motion Principles
nodes.subtitle: Easing curves, choreography, duration, feedback states, Lottie animations
learning_objectives: Design meaningful micro-interactions that provide instant system feedback
Specify cubic-bezier easing curves and animation timing for developers
feynman_prompts: How does UI motion convey spatial relationships between screens?
key_misconceptions: Adding excessive, slow decorative animations that hinder task completion speed

nodes.title: Interactive Prototyping & Usability Testing
nodes.subtitle: Interactive Figma prototypes, smart animate, task-based usability testing, think-aloud protocol
learning_objectives: Build high-fidelity prototypes with realistic variables and micro-interactions
Facilitate unmoderated and moderated usability testing using think-aloud method
feynman_prompts: How do you differentiate a usability issue from a visual preference during testing?
key_misconceptions: Defending your design during a usability test instead of observing where the user struggles

nodes.title: Mobile App UI & Responsive Web Patterns
nodes.subtitle: iOS Human Interface Guidelines (HIG), Android Material Design 3, touch targets, gestures
learning_objectives: Design native mobile experiences respecting iOS and Android platform conventions
Ensure all interactive tap targets exceed 48x48dp minimum requirements
feynman_prompts: Explain the key differences in navigation paradigms between iOS and Android.
key_misconceptions: Treating mobile design as merely shrinking desktop screens down without native ergonomics

nodes.title: Design-to-Code Developer Handoff & Specs
nodes.subtitle: Inspect mode, redlining, edge cases, responsive breakpoints, token documentation
learning_objectives: Document empty states, error states, and extreme text length edge cases for engineers
Conduct design QA sessions on staging builds to catch visual regressions
feynman_prompts: Why is documenting edge cases (like 500-char names or network failure) critical during handoff?
key_misconceptions: Handing off only happy-path static mockups without responsive rules or error states

nodes.title: Product Analytics & Quantitative UX Metrics
nodes.subtitle: SUS (System Usability Scale), CES, NPS, funnels, heatmaps, A/B testing visuals
learning_objectives: Evaluate usability quantitative scores (SUS, SEQ) alongside qualitative findings
Formulate design hypotheses for split-testing UI conversion funnels
feynman_prompts: Explain the complementary relationship between qualitative interviews and quantitative telemetry.
key_misconceptions: Relying purely on A/B testing without understanding why users behaved that way

nodes.title: DesignOps & System Governance at Scale
nodes.subtitle: Component library contribution models, deprecation lifecycles, cross-team design parity
learning_objectives: Manage design system version releases without breaking downstream consumer files
Establish contribution guidelines for cross-functional design updates
feynman_prompts: How does DesignOps prevent design systems from becoming stale and abandoned?
key_misconceptions: Assuming a design system is static once built rather than an evolving product

nodes.title: Enterprise UX & Data-Dense Dashboards
nodes.subtitle: Tables, filters, bulk actions, data visualization, role-based interfaces
learning_objectives: Design complex data tables with column customization, sorting, and pagination
Display multi-dimensional analytical charts while maintaining cognitive clarity
feynman_prompts: How do user workflows differ in consumer apps versus enterprise productivity tools?
key_misconceptions: Over-simplifying enterprise dashboards by hiding critical operational data under endless clicks

nodes.title: Designing for AI & LLM Interfaces
nodes.subtitle: Chat vs canvas, prompt suggestions, latency skeletons, confidence scores, human-in-the-loop
learning_objectives: Design generative AI interfaces that convey probabilistic results and hallucination warnings
Implement streaming token text states and graceful failure fallbacks
feynman_prompts: How do you establish user trust in non-deterministic AI application outputs?
key_misconceptions: Treating AI as a magic black box without giving users controls to inspect or edit output

nodes.title: Product Design Strategy & Business Impact
nodes.subtitle: Design ROI, monetization UX, onboarding funnels, stakeholder alignment
learning_objectives: Tie design improvements directly to business metrics (retention, CAC, ARPU)
Present design decisions persuasively to C-suite and engineering leaders
feynman_prompts: How do you justify redesigning a legacy technical workflow to executive stakeholders?
key_misconceptions: Arguing for design changes based on aesthetic taste rather than user and business impact

nodes.title: Portfolio Presentation & Case Study Storytelling
nodes.subtitle: Problem-solution-impact storytelling, design rationale, trade-off presentation
learning_objectives: Structure comprehensive case studies highlighting research, iterations, and metrics
Articulate design trade-offs and team collaboration effectively in interviews
feynman_prompts: Why is showing discarded iterations more impressive in a portfolio than only polished mockups?
key_misconceptions: Presenting a portfolio as a gallery of final Dribbble shots without problem context or metrics
